turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here? Owen's gradebook says zero, and nobody called me first.
Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
You obviously put the hours in with him. His reading level is years ahead of the class.
Compliments aren't a document. What do you have on the essay?
You're the kind of parent I wish every kid had.
Flattery won't fill the gap, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and on what basis?
So I'd love your blessing to handle this my way. I trust your judgment, and I hope you'll trust mine.
Trust comes from a document with a date on it. What is "your way"?
